title: powerops doctor --format json
description: The JSON written by 'powerops doctor --format json': one entry per check, in a fixed order.

live.description: True when --live ran the sign-in probes and the licence read.

id.description: The check: powerops, pac, az, powerops-plugin, microsoft-plugins, and with --live pac-sign-in, az-sign-in, licences, environment-type. Open, so a later check adds no schemaVersion bump.

status.description: missing and failed set exit code 1.

detail.description: The version, the environment's friendly name, product names, or what to do. Never an account, a tenant, a URL, an account, tenant or environment id, or a part number.
